title: Cipher Origins: audit-bridge for tenant encryption metadata, retention, and rotation visibility
creator: Anita Kapoor
description: Goal: Implement an "audit-bridge" service and supporting metadata model that gives compliance teams tamper-evident visibility into tenant key provenance, configured retention for encryption metadata, and a machine-consumable rotation history stream. This ticket covers: (1) data model for per-tenant key metadata (key_id, kms_provider, region, creation_ts, last_rotation_ts, rotation_reason, policy_version), (2) rules for retention/cleanup of metadata vs. encrypted blobs, (3) an event stream + signed bundles for rotation and KMS lifecycle events, and (4) exports to compliance sinks (S3 audit buckets, SIEM webhook, and SOC-1/2 evidence bundles). The design must support multiple KMS backends (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, and on-prem HSM) and preserve region-level residency labels for each key/event.
acceptance_criteria: 1) New Postgres table 'encryption_keys_meta' (or equivalent) stores required fields and passes schema migration tests; 2) Audit-bridge produces newline-delimited JSON (NDJSON) bundles for each rotation event with canonicalized fields and an ECDSA signature verified by a verification tool; 3) Retention policy engine enforces per-tenant metadata TTLs and provides a dry-run report; 4) Integration tests simulate AWS/GCP KMS rotation events and show end-to-end audit bundle creation and delivery to S3; 5) Dashboard in console shows last rotation, key origin, and retention state per tenant; 6) Performance: audit-bridge adds <5ms median to request path when queried for key info; 7) Security review completed and HSM provider integration validated in staging.
scope: In scope: data model, schema migration, microservice (audit-bridge), event signing, retention engine, unit & integration tests, Console dashboard hooks, export adapters (S3, webhook). Out of scope: full legal reporting templates and on-prem physical HSM procurement (those will be separate tickets).
implementation_notes:
- Use existing key registry patterns from ENG-31402 as a starting point but extend to include 'residency_region' and 'policy_version'.
- Implement audit-bridge as a sidecar-capable stateless service that subscribes to KMS webhooks and our internal rotation bus (Kafka).
- Signing keys: generate a service-key in KMS per-region to sign bundles; verification tool uses public key published via our compliance endpoint.
- Schema migration must be backward compatible; add 'encryption_keys_meta' table with varchar key_id primary key and JSONB column for full raw payload to ease rollbacks.
- Retention toggles: admin per-tenant setting with safe defaults (metadata TTL 7 years, raw payload TTL configurable).
risks_and_mitigation:
Risk: large backlog of historical rotations could create a huge audit store. Mitigation: implement backfill with sampling + allow customers to request full on-demand export; provide a quota and cost estimate.
Risk: signing key compromise. Mitigation: rotate audit-bridge signing key regularly, store signing keys in HSM where available, and keep public key rotation windows short with revocation lists.
Risk: performance impact on request path when verifying keys. Mitigation: cache verification results for short TTLs and offload heavy verification to async jobs for exports.
rollout_plan: 1) Feature-flagged deployment in staging with synthetic tenant and mock KMS providers; 2) Canary deploy audit-bridge to a single region, enable for internal customers only; 3) Run 2-week observability window: check export delivery rate, latency, and CPU/memory; 4) Gradual enablement for customers that requested compliance exports; 5) Enable public verification endpoint and publish docs.
test_plan:
- Unit tests for schema and retention logic.
- Integration tests: simulate AWS/GCP rotation webhooks -> rotation bus -> audit-bridge -> signed bundle -> S3 upload.
- Fuzz tests for malformed KMS payloads.
- Load test: 10k rotation events/hour to ensure NDJSON bundling and export throughput.
- Security tests: signature verification, key compromise simulation, and role boundary checks.
dashboards_and_alerting: Create console dashboard 'Keys: Provenance & Rotation' with widgets: last_rotation_ts per tenant, rotation rate (1h/24h), unsigned_event_count, failed_export_count, audit-queue-depth. Set alerts for failed_export_count > 5/min and audit-queue-depth > 1000.
migration_notes:
- Migration: create 'encryption_keys_meta' table in the same DB shard as tenant metadata to preserve residency constraints.
- Backfill: incremental backfill job that reads rotation messages from archive and writes compacted meta rows; mark backfill progress per-tenant.
- Rollback: if migration fails, keep feature flag off and revert schema changes by dropping new table and clearing backlog consumer offsets.
